description: Address-validation bundle at $0.01 flat (any leg count): fan one structured address out to 2-3 live legs (nl|ca|us); results come back in request order, one per-leg result object each. A 1-leg request refuses free — use the leg tool instead. Canada is available inside this bundle only. Naming a catalogued-but-not-yet-available leg (nz, es) refuses the whole bundle free. Free pre-check: POST /toll/address/bundle/validate/preflight. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/address/bundle/validate.

address.description: Structured address components: street_number, street_name, locality, postcode required; state required when the legs list includes us.

name: address_bundle
